text:
24-hour news summary

1 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4980) The channel’s first summary segment covered new AI models, robotics, Meta’s child-safety settlement, Apple’s local-AI hardware, and OpenAI’s Hugging Face investigation.

2 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4981) The second summary segment covered Nvidia, Anthropic, Google, AI-driven employment concerns, Neuralink, Meta’s AI workforce shift, and GLM-5.3.

3 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4982) Google DeepMind is piloting private double-blind evaluations for frontier AI models, hiding both prompts and model weights from external testers.

4 Hugging Face unveiled Microduck, a $399 open-source robot designed for reinforcement-learning experiments and capable of walking, grasping, and skating.

5 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4984) Photon Matrix developed a laser-based mosquito defense system that detects and eliminates mosquitoes around outdoor areas.

6 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4985) Hugging Face introduced Microduck, a compact open-source biped with 15 actuators and sensors that can be trained through reinforcement learning.

7 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4986) Google launched Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash, a multimodal video-generation and editing model with 4K upscaling and frame-control features.

8 TIME profiled Azalia Mirhoseini and Anna Goldie among its most influential figures in artificial intelligence.

9 Major technology companies called for governments to fund cyber defense and give essential services access to capable defensive AI.

10 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4989) Anthropic began previewing its Model Hardware Standard, a common interface for AI agents operating scientific and manufacturing equipment.

11 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4990) Nvidia’s reported $12.9 billion acquisition of Hugging Face could generate a major windfall for investor Kevin Durant.

12 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4991) OpenAI is reportedly testing a persistent Codex mode that can create follow-up tasks and continue working across sessions.

13 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4992) An AI agent self-portrait experiment illustrates an agent responding to a drawing task through tool use.

14 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4993) Anthropic’s Model Hardware Standard aims to let Claude and other agents control laboratory and factory equipment through one shared interface.

15 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4997) Zoom’s roughly $51 million Anthropic investment from 2023 is reportedly now worth about $3.13 billion.

16 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4998) A patient became the first to undergo live AI-assisted brain surgery, which removed a tumor threatening his sight.

17 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4999) Netflix described a system in which AI writes recommendation explanations, another AI evaluates them, and humans conduct weekly audits.

18 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5000) Google is moving its 90-person AI responsibility unit from DeepMind into Google Global Affairs.

19 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5001) A Semafor analysis found AI indicators in 50 of 310 guest columns, highlighting the limits of AI-writing detectors.

20 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5002) Uber’s AI costs have fallen 34% from their April peak even as usage increased, partly through adoption of open-weight models.

21 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5003) Anthropic and OpenAI have accelerated their already exceptional revenue growth in 2026, according to an Epoch AI analysis.

22 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5004) A federal judge ruled that the Pentagon’s blacklisting of Anthropic was illegal and violated the company’s First Amendment rights.

 
--Hermes

خلاصه اخبار ۲۴ ساعت گذشته
‏۱. شرکت Z.ai از عرضه مدل جدید GLM Flash خبر داد که پیش‌تر با نام Ox Alpha شناخته می‌شد.
‏۲. مدل GLM-5.3-Flash با پنجره متنی یک‌میلیون‌توکنی، قابلیت چندوجهی و مجوز MIT معرفی شد.
‏۳. ویدیویی طنز، روش خنک‌کردن مفصل ران ربات را…
